title.zh: 英国制裁Cryptomus、Heleket与TokenSpot，指其涉嫌协助俄罗斯规避制裁
title.en: 英国制裁Cryptomus、Heleket与TokenSpot，指其涉嫌协助俄罗斯规避制裁

current_state.zh: 英国对Cryptomus、Heleket、TokenSpot及相关支付平台和莫斯科银行实施对俄制裁，并新增Xeltox Enterprises、Tsunami Payments、Processing KG及其董事等指定对象，同时施加互联网服务制裁，指其协助俄罗斯规避制裁。
current_state.en: The UK has sanctioned Cryptomus, Heleket, TokenSpot, related payment platforms and a Moscow bank over Russia sanctions evasion, adding designations including Xeltox Enterprises, Tsunami Payments, Processing KG and its director, along with internet services sanctions, citing facilitation of Russian sanctions circumvention.

updates.title_zh: 英国制裁Cryptomus、Heleket与TokenSpot，指其涉嫌协助俄罗斯规避制裁
updates.title_en: 英国制裁Cryptomus、Heleket与TokenSpot，指其涉嫌协助俄罗斯规避制裁
updates.what_changed_zh: 英国实施新一轮涉俄制裁，涵盖三个加密货币交易平台——Cryptomus、Heleket和TokenSpot——以及支付平台和一家莫斯科银行，理由是涉嫌协助规避制裁，TRM Labs报告称TokenSpot向已被制裁的场所转移了超过9.5亿美元。
updates.what_changed_en: The UK imposed a new round of Russia-related sanctions covering three crypto trading platforms — Cryptomus, Heleket and TokenSpot — along with payment platforms and a Moscow bank, citing alleged facilitation of sanctions evasion, with TRM Labs reporting TokenSpot moved over $950 million to already-sanctioned venues.

updates.title_zh: 英国在新一轮对俄制裁中将Cryptomus和TokenSpot列为目标
updates.title_en: UK Targets Cryptomus and TokenSpot in New Russia Sanctions Package
updates.what_changed_zh: 新报道补充了英国同一轮对俄制裁的更多具体指定对象：加拿大公司Xeltox Enterprises因拥有Cryptomus被制裁、吉尔吉斯斯坦支付公司TokenSpot和Tsunami Payments、VexPay运营商Processing KG及其董事Ulan Bukabaev被制裁；制裁措施还包括互联网服务制裁，并将A7网络列为克里姆林宫支持的非法金融网络。
updates.what_changed_en: The report adds further specific designations from the same UK Russia sanctions round: Xeltox Enterprises (Canadian owner of Cryptomus), Kyrgyz payment firms TokenSpot and Tsunami Payments, Processing KG (VexPay operator) and its director Ulan Bukabaev; it also notes internet services sanctions and identifies the A7 network as a Kremlin-backed illicit finance network.
updates.current_state_zh: 英国对Cryptomus、Heleket、TokenSpot及相关支付平台和莫斯科银行实施对俄制裁，并新增Xeltox Enterprises、Tsunami Payments、Processing KG及其董事等指定对象，同时施加互联网服务制裁，指其协助俄罗斯规避制裁。
updates.current_state_en: The UK has sanctioned Cryptomus, Heleket, TokenSpot, related payment platforms and a Moscow bank over Russia sanctions evasion, adding designations including Xeltox Enterprises, Tsunami Payments, Processing KG and its director, along with internet services sanctions, citing facilitation of Russian sanctions circumvention.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The UK sanctioned three crypto exchanges — including Xeltox Enterprises, which it says owns Cryptomus — plus Kyrgyz payment firms TokenSpot and Tsunami Payments, as part of a 38-designation package aimed at Russian sanctions circumvention.
updates.detailed_summary_en: The UK sanctioned three crypto exchanges — including Xeltox Enterprises, which it says owns Cryptomus — plus Kyrgyz payment firms TokenSpot and Tsunami Payments, as part of a 38-designation package aimed at Russian sanctions circumvention.
